alt: November 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of a sunlit home office: a wooden desk with a laptop and mugs, a blue office chair, plants and a tree by a large window. Guru Nanak’s birthday is marked.
caption: A watercolor illustration of a cozy home office for the November 2025 calendar.
description: A soft watercolor print depicts a sun-drenched study nook featuring a wooden desk and blue office chair. Multiple potted plants, including a tall tree and trailing vines, add greenery around a large window. The calendar grid below marks November 2025, noting Guru Nanak B Day on the fifth.
